criteria.description: The document includes concrete numbers (counts, dates, amounts) that ground its claims.
criteria.name: concrete numbers

criteria.description: The document includes a worked example that shows the idea in action.
criteria.name: worked example

criteria.description: The document ends with a clear recommendation the reader can act on.
criteria.name: clear recommendation

criteria.description: The document is at most 25 words.
criteria.name: concise

workItem.content: Welcome aboard. This note describes how our group works together. We prize honesty, patience, and steady effort. Bring questions to the weekly sync, offer help before being asked, and document decisions so others can follow. Together we will ship useful work and keep improving.
